notes.title: Demo Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Witches & Wizards, 

We finally have the official release date for the Pumpkin Woods Demo!

  [b]   [/b]* * *[b] [i]SEPTEMBER 4TH[/i][/b] * * *

The new update will include many quality of life features, new content and a ton of bug fixes thanks to your valuable feedback during the playtest! The full changelog will be released at launch, but here is a short preview of the [b]new features[/b]:  
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/57725d5236c5f44224a2a179476555af87b61e11.png"][/img][/p][p]The UI has been revamped to be simple and intuitive. Possible actions are now displayed on the right of the screen. This includes interacting with items, animals, doors, wells and furniture within range. Also, bonus effects on health will show at the top left (mushroom poisoning, fairy dust healing, etc). Bonus effects on happiness, hunger and thirst are still not shown to avoid information overload.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/4c022d413a6d4c24499b2508764a8ac65e473fe3.png"][/img][/p][p]We're working to add more handcrafted areas within our procedurally generated system![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/78c7273d9169a910c20844254375a575a5d89b44.png"][/img][/p][p]New quest to rescue an injured unicorn lost in the dark woods! Unlike most unicorns, this one may be tamed if you play your cards right. The pet system is now modular, which opens the path to possibly having more tameable animals in the future.
[/p][p]Out of 6 biomes on Early Access release, 3 will be fully available in the demo.
[/p][p]Join our Discord for more relevant info![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ"]https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ[/url][/p]

notes.title: Flying, Map & Quests Update
notes.notes:
Flying, Map System & Quests Update

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/c7e12c4a31fa39e5025e98a20b63558785b5656b.png[/img]
Changelog Version 0.1.6

- Flying and crafting a wagon is now enabled!
- New map system with fog showing huts, campfires, torches, cats and NPCs
- Added 6 new tutorial quests
- A new quest for each NPC vendor (3 total)
- Added a "fine" version of 4 tools, which lasts 3x longer
- Crafting basic tools no longer require an anvil
- Added advanced book of tools
- Pots and wheels are now craftable
- New broom flying animation and improved controls
- Added scroll to craft a key to open the witch tower
- Better pet (cat) behavior with several new animations
- Harvested logs now provide firewood instead of planks
- Firewood can be further cut down to obtain planks
- Added 2 new fancy food types
- Honey and cheese wheel are now craftable
- Boars, bears and deers now have optimized AI pathing
- Chill mode now has non-aggressive boars and bears (unless provoked)
- New idle animations for several animals and creatures
- Added signposts and other scenery to some biomes
- Added many sound effects for animals and creatures
- Added new furniture to the townhall building
- Added toys in some abandoned houses
- Shops no longer sell fabric and planks to incentivize crafting
- Calafate berries are now slightly poisonous
- Kozinak can now be sold at the shops
- Muzzarella pizza now contains 8 slices
- Updated meshes of toast, cake and wild berries jam

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/f7f14b39f503c7f58ef1db641ad93833a7632b5c.png[/img]
Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where the chill mode incorrectly had monsters
- Fixed a bug where sometimes tutorial quests would not complete
- Minor fixes and adjustments

Quality of Life Features

- Massive optimization effort, reducing total poly count by 25%
- Average frames per second improved by about 35%
- All icons were upgraded with a higher quality version
- Minor UI improvements

Important Note:

Due to the procedural generation nature of the game, saves from previous versions do not feature new content. For the best experience, please start a new world.

We'd love to hear your feedback on our Discord channel!
https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ

notes.title: Wardrobe, Food & Catacombs Update
notes.notes:
Dresser now enables 72 outfit combinations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/6a2440f844286d6a2330088e283f9d6ba9664443.gif[/img]

- Added 8 new types of food
- Added catacombs to the Swamp biome
- Added bear and crop area to the Mining Town biome
- Added old cemetery to the Pumpkin Woods biome
- Added snake and flying fantasy creature to the Swamp biome
- Added horse enclosure to the starting biome
- Added advanced recipe book
- Bookcases in tower, townhalls and NPC houses are now interactable
- Player can craft fences and vault over them by pressing F
- Stack size of sticks, rocks and pinecones increased from 10 to 20
- Potions can now be sold at the shops for 120 gold
- Increased selling value of fairy dust and moonjuice
- Hunted animals and creatures now drop meat
- Fences updated with better visuals and optimization
- Player can craft spiked fences for protection
- Huts now have a chest with random items
- Firewood added to the Mining Town biome and near huts
- Townhall building no longer requires keys to open the door
- Potion essences had their ingredients updated
- Cauldrons in use have better visual effects and happiness aura
- Spiderweb negative happiness aura reduced
- Upgraded icons for several items
- Pumpkin pulp mesh updated

Bug Fixes

- Fixed a persistent bug where the player would refuse to sleep
- Increased hitbox for logs, ferns, crystals, mud and spiderwebs
- Increased hitbox for furniture inside huts
- Minor fixes and adjustments

Quality of Life Features

- Added screen resolution settings (1920x1080 recommended)
- Ladders now have tooltip to indicate they can be climbed with F
- Improved optimization for carved pumpkins and wagons
- Furniture, props and resources now display HP bar when damaged
- Minor UI improvements

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/2100c596b137ab728a4463479feeaf23226f39e4.png[/img]
Important Note:

Due to the procedural generation nature of the game, saves from previous versions do not feature new content. For the best experience, please start a new world.

If you decide to join the playtest, we'd love to hear your feedback in the Steam forums or directly on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ

notes.title: Largest Update Yet
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/3adbbacba51ca943dfbe51d218b23319409fcb6f.png[/img]
Changelog Version 0.1.3

- 5 new tutorial quests
- Mining Town biome redesigned
- Temples added to the Enchanted Forest
- Tools now have durability (100 hits until it's destroyed)
- Added 4 new food items
- Added 2 new types of flowers
- Added fiber to the square fences
- Added nests on some large rocks
- Added craftable trap that can damage creatures
- Destroyed furniture now returns all crafting resources
- Player can now sleep on NPC beds
- Player can smell flowers in inventory
- Cat colliders reduced to improve pathing
- Wolves had their line of sight reduced to attack and chase less often
- Monster AI now actively chases the player instead of going in random directions
- Increased selling value of several items, including ores and ingots
- Improved boar AI to reduce chance of getting stuck
- Rebalanced consumable effects of most food items
- Cats now have happiness aura around them
- Reduced happiness aura effect near the fire
- Standing torch no longer can be built on top of objects
- Fixed camera clipping through windows
- Upgraded rope mesh
- Updated icons for many items
- Minor fixes and adjustments

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/d8cad74d5c08a2a487b99750da32d32afc664af8.png[/img]
Quality of Life Features

- Added notifications when items are picked up
- Stats frame can now be toggled on/off by pressing H
- External objects can be built at a greater distance
- Holding SHIFT now allows you to craft or build multiple times
- Pressing Escape while having open panels only close them instead of pausing the game
- Increased hitbox size of thorn and fern so they're much easier to harvest
- Minor UI improvements

Important Note:

If you start a new game from the main menu, it may load quest progress from a previous save.
Press Esc and start a new game again - progress will be reset and the first quest "Gather" will appear.
This bug is being investigated but for now follow this step and it should work without any issues.

Due to the procedural generation nature of the game, saves from previous versions do not feature new content. For the best experience, please start a new world.

If you decide to join the playtest, we'd love to hear your feedback in the Steam forums or directly on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ

notes.title: Halloween Cat Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/2100c596b137ab728a4463479feeaf23226f39e4.png[/img]

In celebration of Halloween, the new Cat update just dropped and is now live! In addition to having cats as pets, there is now an entirely new Autumn biome! Pumpkin Woods is also taking part in the upcoming Steam Scream Fest 3 from October 28th to November 4th, so this update was focused on giving new players a smoother experience at the start.

Changelog Version 0.1.2

- Added an entirely new Autumn biome
- Added cats that can be tamed with a cheese slice by pressing F
- Pet cats can be ordered to switch between stay/follow behavior by pressing F
- Added craftable standing torch to avoid getting lost
- Added deer
- Axe and dagger no longer require a book to be crafted
- Books are now cheaper and can be sold at the shops
- Reduced damage from wild animals and plants
- Reduced poison effects from moonjuice and some mushrooms
- Hunger now depletes faster while not sleeping
- Rebalanced cart spawning for essential items
- Improved ground textures
- Fixed a bug where you couldn't use the anvil
- Pausing the game with Escape now properly hides journal
- Minor UI improvements
- Minor fixes and adjustments

Saves from previous versions are not supported. Please start a new world.

We hope you are as excited as we are and can't wait to listen to your feedback!
Join our Discord for any questions and more information: https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ
